topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: Imagine my surprise when I stumbled upon my college application essay, not tucked away in some forgotten folder, but right there, prominently displayed as an exemplary piece. The words that I poured my heart into, somehow, resonated with others enough to be showcased. It’s a peculiar feeling, seeing a part of yourself out there, doing its own thing, making others stop and think. The meticulous crafting of each sentence, the countless revisions—every effort seems to have found its purpose. It’s a quiet affirmation that maybe, just maybe, the anxious nights and restless thoughts were worth it.
